def find_permutation(n, k):
    permutation = []
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        if k > 0:
            permutation.append(i + k + n)
            permutation.append(i)
            k -= 1
        else:
            permutation.append(i + n)
            permutation.append(i)
    return permutation
